method: Read official Census web pages, small layout SAS source and official technical documentation; no microdata/replicate data download.

asec_replicates_exist.meaning: Current official pages list ASEC person replicate weight data and instructions. This does not establish Nov Voting supplement replicate files.

conclusion.variance: CPS SDR direct variance: (4/160) * sum((theta_r - theta_0)^2), r=1..160, as documented in CPS methodological sources.

voting_replicate_file_observed.scope: Not observed in year-specific voting pages or the official year /supp directory listings checked. This is not a proof of global nonexistence.

conclusion.vintage: Exact first-public-release timestamps and then-current bytes for the ASEC replicate files were not established. Current page revisions and FTP Last modified values are not treated as first-release proof.

limitations: No microdata or replicate-weight data files were downloaded or joined.
ASEC files concern March income/economic supplement data and are not validated as weights for November voting responses.
No exact first public release timestamp or historical byte snapshot for 2018/2020 ASEC replicate files was established.
Absence of a file in the inspected Voting year page and directory is an observed-link/listing limit, not proof of nonexistence elsewhere.
The generic person-replicate Word instruction was linked from Census but not rendered by the web tool, so no voting-specific key/formula claim is based on it.
